analysis.marker_count_feasibility: 179 markers is extremely modest for modern GPU vector map rendering pipelines (Google Maps SDK / Apple MapKit easily handle thousands without frame drops)
analysis.clustering_complexity_cost: Introducing android-maps-utils or custom QuadTree spatial clustering adds heavy state churn, recomposition thrashing, and third-party dependency bloat

decision.android: Native Marker rendering with category filtering, district camera scoping, and mutual exclusivity layers
decision.ios: SwiftUI.Map native Marker presentation with category filtering and camera scoping
decision.rationale: Ponytail compliance: 179 canonical destinations render at native 60fps without clustering artifacts, jitter, or phantom coordinate jumps.
